# Table

Semantic HTML table primitives in a horizontally scrollable wrapper. Headers use the eyebrow style; rows tint on hover and when selected (data-state=selected).

## Import

```tsx

// or the per-component entry point
```

Exports: `Table`, `TableBody`, `TableCaption`, `TableCell`, `TableFooter`, `TableHead`, `TableHeader`, `TableRow`.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `table.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
